use_when.statement: Use a toggle for one setting that takes effect immediately — "Write summary with AI" in the report builder.
use_when.verbatim: Use a toggle for one setting that takes effect immediately — "Write summary with AI" in the report builder.

dont_use_when.verbatim: Don’t use it when the change needs a Save action; use Checkbox for that.

placement.statement: in a settings row, with the label naming the setting

a11y.fact: renders a real <button role="switch"> with aria-checked, so Space and Enter operate it and a screen reader reads the state
uses aria-disabled rather than the DOM disabled attribute, so a disabled switch stays focusable and can still be read
the node carries no label layer, so the accessible name must come from the caller via aria-label or aria-labelledby
the knob is aria-hidden; the parent button is the control, so the knob must not be focusable or announced
